description: Defines a template class 'bounded_integer' representing integers within specified bounds, with associated utility functions, assertions, and formatting support.

classes.name: bounded_integer
classes.description: A class template for integers constrained within specified minimum and maximum bounds, supporting arithmetic operations, validation, and formatting.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value bound for the bounded_integer.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value bound for the bounded_integer.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current value is within bounds.

methods.name: operator Integer()
methods.description: Cast operator to convert bounded_integer to primitive integer.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the stored raw integer value.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Pre-increment operator, increases value within bounds.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds a value or another bounded_integer to current value, with bounds check.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Subtracts a value or another bounded_integer from current value, with bounds check.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Returns a new bounded_integer as sum of current and another value or bounded_integer.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Returns the difference between two bounded_integers.
